form.label: Infrastructure inventory
form.description: Inspect the latest complete inventory snapshots for each connected server.

search.query: `zabbix_events` earliest=-7d | stats count by instance | fields instance

div.p: Inspect the latest complete inventory snapshots for each connected server.

html.p: Inventory panels use snapshot completion markers. Choose a range containing a recent successful snapshot; absence of rows is not proof of health. SLA records are definitions, not computed SLI percentages.

search.query: `zabbix_events` instance=$instance|s$ (sourcetype=zabbix:hosts OR (sourcetype=zabbix:snapshot snapshot_dataset=hosts)) | eventstats max(_time) AS last_snapshot by instance | where _time=last_snapshot AND dataset="hosts" | table instance dest name status raw.interfaces{}.* raw.inventory.*

`zabbix_events` instance=$instance|s$ (sourcetype=zabbix:problems OR (sourcetype=zabbix:snapshot snapshot_dataset=problems)) | eventstats max(_time) AS last_snapshot by instance | where _time=last_snapshot AND dataset="problems" | table instance severity name acknowledged eventid raw.tags{}.*

`zabbix_events` instance=$instance|s$ (sourcetype=zabbix:items OR (sourcetype=zabbix:snapshot snapshot_dataset=items)) | eventstats max(_time) AS last_snapshot by instance | where _time=last_snapshot AND dataset="items" AND 'raw.state'="1" | table instance dest itemid name key_ raw.error

`zabbix_events` instance=$instance|s$ (sourcetype=zabbix:proxies OR sourcetype=zabbix:services OR sourcetype=zabbix:sla OR sourcetype=zabbix:maintenance) | sort 0 -_time | dedup instance dataset object_id | table _time instance dataset name raw
